The '''White Wolf Mountain''' is a natural region in the [[members]]-only area. It acts as a mountainous border between [[Taverley]] and [[Catherby]], and as a borderline between the kingdoms of [[Asgarnia]] and [[Kandarin]]. The mountain is notorious for being a dangerous area for low levelled players wishing to travel to Kandarin. The [[Ice Queen's Lair]] can be found beneath the mountain, where players can fight the [[Ice Queen]] during [[Heroes' Quest]].

==Transportation==
===White Wolf Tunnel===
{{Main|White Wolf Tunnel}}
Once a player has completed the [[Fishing Contest]] [[quest]], a [[White Wolf Tunnel|tunnel]] that travels underneath the mountain becomes accessible. This tunnel features a cart station that leads to [[Keldagrim]]. The tunnel proves especially useful to low-level players because it avoids the dangerous monsters that live on White Wolf Mountain.

===Glider===
A [[gnome glider]] manned by [[Captain Bleemadge]] is located at the centre peak of the mountain, but it is only accessible to players after they have completed [[The Grand Tree]] quest.

===Grapple shortcut===
There is a [[mithril grapple]] [[Agility]] shortcut located at the entrance of the mountain (when coming from Catherby) that requires 35 [[Strength]], 35 [[Ranged]], 32 Agility. This shortcut, however, can only be used when travelling from Catherby to Taverley.
